rule: AGENTS.md Multi-tenancy: never rely on settings.SITE_ID
naive: Fetch the shop settings with Site.objects.get(pk=settings.SITE_ID) (or SiteSettings.objects.get()/first()) inside the mutation instead of resolving the current site with get_site_promise(info.context) / Site.objects.get_current(), which breaks when SITE_ID is unset and the site must be resolved from the request host.
